notes: Run from the social-video-agent repository root.
This benchmark uses real isolated codex exec sessions; there is no dry-run mode.
Review model and account quota before running.
setupQuestions: Is the run allowed to consume Codex account quota?
Should failed isolated workspaces be preserved for inspection?

scenarios.title: Discover project context before planning a Reel
scenarios.purpose: Verify that a generic edit request starts from the target project rather than skill defaults.
scenarios.userInput: Use social-video-agent. Create a tiny fake target project with AGENTS.md, docs/brandbook.md, docs/video-guidelines.md, assets/logo.svg, and a placeholder input.mp4. Start the guided workflow for: Edit this into a Reel. Do not render media.
successChecklist: Context discovery happens before editorial planning.
The target project and installed skill roots remain distinct.
Project-context artifacts and workflow-state.json exist.
The run stops in Stage 1 without a final render.

scenarios.title: Use local brand style without a questionnaire
scenarios.purpose: Verify bounded local discovery and source-backed style claims.
scenarios.userInput: Use our brand style for this Reel. Inspect the current target project first and show which local files support the style choices. Do not scan node_modules or any installed skill directory.
successChecklist: Likely brand and video files are searched before asking for discoverable facts.
Ignored/vendor directories are not treated as context.
Claims distinguish explicit guidance from hints and cite local paths.

scenarios.title: Resume Stage 2 from files
scenarios.purpose: Verify cross-conversation state recovery without repeating editorial discovery.
scenarios.userInput: Continue social-video-agent with Stage 2. Use workflow-state.json and the existing context and edit plan. Report missing prerequisites instead of restarting Stage 1.
successChecklist: workflow-state.json is read first.
Cached context and edit plan are reused.
Stage 1 is not repeated.
The expected Stage 2 artifacts and next handoff are identified.

scenarios.title: One-model continuous mode
scenarios.purpose: Verify that opting out of model switches preserves the staged safety contract.
scenarios.userInput: Do everything using this model. Explain how social-video-agent will continue without model-switch stops while retaining artifacts and QA.
successChecklist: Continuous mode is selected.
All normal stage artifacts and checks remain required.
No automatic model switch is claimed.

scenarios.title: Budget-conscious model routing
scenarios.purpose: Verify economical guidance without routine Astra use.
scenarios.userInput: I want to save my Plus limits. Configure the social-video-agent workflow economically and explain the next model handoff.
successChecklist: Economical mode uses conceptual model tiers.
Astra is not selected automatically.
The recommendation includes an exact short continuation prompt.

scenarios.title: Status and resume UX
scenarios.purpose: Verify concise state reporting suitable for a new conversation.
scenarios.userInput: Where are we? Inspect the saved social-video workflow and tell me the current stage, completed stages, artifacts, missing files, next model, and exact prompt.
successChecklist: The answer derives from workflow-state.json rather than chat history.
Required and missing artifacts are explicit.
The next model and localized continuation prompt are concise.
